name: OMathFunc
description: Represents the application of a function or an argument in an equation that consists of a function name, such as sin or cos, and an argument.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathFunc object.

properties.name: FName
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the name of a mathematical function, such as sin or cos. Read-only.

properties.name: E
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the base of the specified equation object. Read-only.
